name: India Home Loan Limited
about: India Home Loan Limited operates as a housing finance company in India. It offers home loans to individuals and families for purchase, construction, extension, renovation, and improvement; loan against property to individuals who own self-occupied residential properties; project finance; and mortgage loans. The company was formerly known as Manoj Housing Finance Company Ltd and changed its name to India Home Loan Limited in 2009. India Home Loan Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
